paragraphs: 4 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Tuesday for 4 clubs across 2 levels, with Bryan Woo producing the night's most notable performance.
Bryan Woo worked 5.0 innings, allowing 3 hits and 0 earned runs, with 1 walk and 5 strikeouts.
One of his strikeouts came in the first, on a 0-2 pitch a 98 mph sinker to strike out Heliot Ramos.
Seattle Mariners fell to New York Yankees, 1-4.
Brooks Lee also appeared for Minnesota Twins. He went 2-for-4, 1 double, 1 RBI. He batted 6th and started at 3B. Minnesota Twins fell to Baltimore Orioles, 2-5.
Ryan Tayman also appeared for St. Lucie Mets at Single-A. He went 3-for-3. He batted 5th and started at C. St. Lucie Mets fell to Jupiter Hammerheads, 2-3.
Alejandro Garza also appeared for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. He went 1-for-4, 1 stolen base. He batted 8th and started at 2B. Hill City Howlers beat Myrtle Beach Pelicans, 9-4.
Away from the box scores, there was also roster movement involving former Mustangs.
Alejandro Garza was called up on Tuesday, moving from the Rookie ACL Guardians to the Single-A Hill City Howlers.
